world.name: Avalon
world.premise: In the mystical land of Avalon, ancient magic stirs beneath a fragile peace as rival factions vie for control over legendary relics that could reshape the fate of the realm.

regions.name: The Verdant Expanse
regions.notes: Lush forests and rolling hills, home to druidic enclaves and hidden groves.

regions.name: The Shattered Coast
regions.notes: Jagged cliffs and stormy seas, dotted with pirate coves and ancient shipwrecks.

regions.name: The Ember Wastes
regions.notes: A scorched desert with ruins of a lost civilization and volatile magical storms.

regions.name: The Silver Peaks
regions.notes: Snow-capped mountains inhabited by reclusive clans and mystical creatures.

landmarks.name: The Crystal Spire
landmarks.notes: A towering magical obelisk said to be a conduit to the realm of the gods.

landmarks.name: The Whispering Glade
landmarks.notes: An enchanted forest where the trees are rumored to speak secrets.

landmarks.name: The Sunken Citadel
landmarks.notes: Ruins beneath the Shattered Coast, rumored to hold powerful relics.

cultures.name: The Sylvani
cultures.traits: Forest dwellers with deep ties to nature magic, valuing harmony and secrecy.

cultures.name: The Ironborn
cultures.traits: Coastal warriors and traders, known for their shipbuilding and fierce independence.

cultures.name: The Ashen Nomads
cultures.traits: Desert wanderers skilled in survival and elemental magic, valuing freedom and resilience.

cultures.name: The Highland Clans
cultures.traits: Mountain tribes with a strong warrior tradition and ancestral reverence.

magic.sources: Magic in Avalon is drawn from ley lines, ancient relics, and personal willpower.
magic.costs: Casting spells consumes stamina and mental focus; overuse risks magical burnout or physical harm.
magic.limits: Magic cannot create life or alter fundamental laws of nature; powerful spells require rare components or rituals.

technology.notes: Predominantly sword and sorcery era with limited mechanical devices; some alchemical innovations exist.

factions.name: The Arcane Conclave
factions.agenda: Preserve and control magical knowledge to maintain balance and prevent misuse.
factions.assets: Libraries, magical artifacts, and influential scholars.

factions.name: The Black Tide
factions.agenda: Expand their pirate dominion along the Shattered Coast and control sea trade.
factions.assets: Fleet of ships, hidden coves, and mercenaries.

factions.name: The Ember Circle
factions.agenda: Harness the power of the Ember Wastes to unlock forgotten elemental magic.
factions.assets: Desert strongholds, elemental mages, and ancient relics.

factions.name: The Silver Guard
factions.agenda: Protect the Highland Clans and uphold ancient oaths against external threats.
factions.assets: Elite warriors, mountain fortresses, and ancestral weapons.

economy.trade: Trade routes connect regions exchanging rare herbs, metals, magical components, and crafted goods.

bestiary.name: Glimmerfox
bestiary.role: Elusive forest creature that can bend light to become nearly invisible.

bestiary.name: Storm Drake
bestiary.role: Small dragon-like beings that control localized weather patterns.

bestiary.name: Ash Wraith
bestiary.role: Spirit of the Ember Wastes that drains life energy from travelers.

bestiary.name: Silverstag
bestiary.role: Majestic mountain deer believed to be omens of great change.

hooks: A legendary relic has been stolen from the Crystal Spire, threatening the balance of magic.
Strange storms are ravaging the Shattered Coast, disrupting trade and awakening ancient sea creatures.
A mysterious plague spreads through the Ember Wastes, linked to forbidden elemental magic.
The Highland Clans seek aid against an encroaching enemy from beyond the Silver Peaks.
safety_tools: Establish lines and veils to define content boundaries
Use the X-card for on-the-fly discomfort signaling
Session zero discussion to set player expectations and consent
Regular check-ins during sessions to ensure comfort
dice_prompts: Roll to determine a character's secret motivation (1-6: personal gain, 7-12: loyalty, 13-18: revenge, 19-20: prophecy)
Roll to generate a random magical side effect when casting a spell
Roll to decide the weather conditions during travel
Roll to determine the disposition of a newly encountered faction or NPC
